purpose: Explain the Telegram assistant's subagent architecture and workflow

required_facts.fact: A single context became overloaded by voice notes, links, research and resources.
The main agent coordinates and processes voice messages.
article-summarizer uses Jina Reader for external URLs.
resource-describer writes two to four sentence resource descriptions.
verify-content checks omissions against original voice messages.
Audio files such as MP4 and M4A are supported.
YouTube links are processed through transcripts.
create-slides and slides-to-pdf are used for workshops.

author_attribution: Describe the assistant as Alexey's system and preserve the roles of its agents.
